Ryuk.PassiveDescription:
Each skill use applies Name Written to an enemy.
Randomly selects a Name Written enemy to either lose 20% HP or gain 20% Permanent Slow.
Each skill use grants +5% ATK, up to 50%.

Yuta_Awakened.PassiveDescription:
Attacks apply Copy Mark. Hitting the marked enemy again copies 10–20% DMG permanently. Only 1 enemy can be copied.
Deploying 2+ units from the same series: -50% HP & DMG, -20% Upgrade Cost, Deploy Cost & SPA.
Deploying only 1: +50% HP & DMG.
Yuta_Awakened.UltimateDescription:
Attacks all enemies within this unit's range, dealing +100% DMG based on Skill DMG.
Grants +10 Shield to all allied units.
Can only be used once per game.

Basil.PassiveDescription:
Critical attacks inflict Fear, pushing affected enemies back.
When a Tsunayoshi unit is present, every 3rd Normal Attack from Tsunayoshi also inflicts Fear.

Vegeta.PassiveDescription:
Every 3 attacks will trigger +1 bonus attack.
Upon placement, if there is a teammate's unit deployed before this one, it automatically grants that previous unit +2 upgrade levels, +40% speed, and instantly resets all skill cooldowns for both that unit and self.
This placement effect can only be used once per game.

Goku.PassiveDescription:
If this unit does not attack, its main stats will decrease by 5% (stackable).
The effect resets when the unit is redeployed, and grants +5% main stats upon redeployment.

Elfaria.PassiveDescription: When a friendly Will is eliminated, this unit locks onto the killer instantly with <font color='rgb(0,255,0)'>+50% DMG</font> regardless of distance, inflicting a <font color='rgb(0,180,255)'>10s Freeze</font> and a <font color='rgb(200,0,0)'>5s Bleed</font> debuff

Mahito.PassiveDescription: Attacks have a 35% chance to apply Soul Mark (Stun).

Goku_Awakened.PassiveDescription:
When hit by an Enemy Skill, this unit automatically upgrades by 1 Level. This effect has a 5s cooldown.
If there is another ally from the same Series, all allies from that Series gain Armor Pierce equal to 1.5% of their Damage.

NaoyaPlayer.PassiveDescription:
Hunt Mode: Increases Damage by +15% and Speed by +12%.
Defense Mode: Reduces Attack Interval (SPA) by -15%, but inflicts Curse debuff on all deployed allies from the JJK series.

Lancer.PassiveDescription:
Each attack has a 30% chance to be 100% accurate. A 100% accurate attack inflicts Bleed (10% of DMG) for 5s.
When it triggers, this unit's base HP is converted into %HP for itself and Fate allies: every 500 HP = +20% HP (Max 50%).

Frieza_Player.PassiveDescription:
Energy Gauge (100): Loses 1 Energy/sec while moving. Reaching 0 Energy inflicts Sleep and triggers 1 of 3 Random Auras:
• Blue Aura: Instantly restores +50 Energy (Wakes up).
• Red Aura: +50% Damage buff.
• Purple Aura: +50% HP buff.
Defense Mode Charge: Restores +1 Energy every 0.2s. Reaching 100 Energy purifies all debuffs.
Speed Scaling: Speed scales with Energy (100 Energy = +10% Speed).
Death Retaliation: If this unit dies in Defense Mode with < 3 Energy, inflicts 50% Slow on all enemies in range for 4s.

Frieza.PassiveDescription:
Energy Gauge (100): Loses 1 Energy/sec while moving. Reaching 0 Energy inflicts Sleep and triggers 1 of 3 Random Auras:
• Blue Aura: Instantly restores +50 Energy (Wakes up).
• Red Aura: +50% Damage buff.
• Purple Aura: +50% HP buff.
Defense Mode Charge: Restores +1 Energy every 0.2s. Reaching 100 Energy purifies all debuffs.
Speed Scaling: Speed scales with Energy (100 Energy = +10% Speed).
Death Retaliation: If this unit dies in Defense Mode with < 3 Energy, inflicts 50% Slow on all enemies in range for 4s.

Gojo.PassiveDescription:
Has a permanent 20% Dodge Chance to avoid all incoming attacks.
If this unit has not been hit since deployment,
its Dodge Chance becomes 100%.
This effect resets upon Upgrade.

Naoya.PassiveDescription:
Hunt Mode: Increases Damage by +15% and Speed by +12%.
Defense Mode: Reduces Attack Interval (SPA) by -15%, but inflicts Curse debuff on all deployed allies from the JJK series.

Sasuke.PassiveDescription: This unit applies the <font color='rgb(255,105,180)'>Eye Debuff</font> to enemies. (Eye Debuff = disables the enemy’s dodge ability.) Once the debuff is triggered, it will be removed.

Gohan.PassiveDescription:
Attacking the same enemy repeatedly increases damage by 7% each hit (Max 50%) for 5 seconds.
If a unit from the DGB series is deployed, this unit will also be deployed automatically.
Additionally, if Goku (Saiyan) or Goku dies within range, this unit will instantly upgrade to its maximum level.

Astolfo.PassiveDescription:
While in Defense Mode, generates +150 Cash/ 2 sec.
This income is increased by 1.5× with each upgrade.

Bulma.PassiveDescription: While in <font color='rgb(50,150,255)'>Defense Mode</font>, increases <font color='rgb(255,215,0)'>Max Currency by 50</font> plus <font color='rgb(255,180,0)'>100 per Upgrade Level</font>.

Sakai.PassiveDescription:
Every 10s, gains a random amount of Mastery Stacks (Max 999). Each stack grants +0.05% DMG.
At 999 Stacks, this unit is afflicted with Curse.

Itachi.PassiveDescription: When sold, grants <font color='rgb(0,255,0)'>+10% DMG</font> to teammates and retains this bonus for its next placement (Caps based on current upgrade level). This buff resets completely upon <font color='rgb(255,120,120)'>death</font>.

Elfaria_Awakened.PassiveDescription:
When an ally Will takes damage exceeding 90%, this unit sacrifices its own HP to restore Will's HP to 99.99%.
Additionally, each of this unit's attacks randomly cycles through 3 different forms.
Upon the first teammate using an Active Skill after this unit is deployed, a massive AOE Ice Explosion triggers right after that skill ends; surviving enemies are Slowed by 6% (once per deployment).
This unit's basic attacks will also clone itself to strike targets alongside teammates.
Elfaria_Awakened.UltimateDescription:
Grants +50% DMG to all allied units of the same series within this unit's Range.
Grants +30% HP to allied Water units.
Deals Line AOE DMG.
All effects last 20s and do not stack when recast.

Naruto_Awakened.PassiveDescription: Automatically deploys <font color="#FFD700"><u>free, max upgraded Clones</u></font> when enemies get <font color="#FF8C00">close to the base</font>. Summons respect the standard <font color="#00BFFF">placement limit</font> and <font color="#FF4444">cannot go over the cap</font>.

Choso.PassiveDescription:
When this unit Lifesteals, the enemy is inflicted with Bleed for 2s. Each Bleed hit adds 1 Blood Stack (Max 10).
At 10 Stacks, triggers Blood Detonate, dealing 20% of current DMG and resetting the stacks.
Each Blood Detonate grants this unit and JJK allies with Abyss or Noctis element +15% HP (Max +100%).
At +100% HP, those units gain +50% Base DMG and +25% Range.

Hainiya.PassiveDescription: When in <font color='rgb(0,150,255)'>Defense Mode</font>, increases max currency by <font color='rgb(255,215,0)'>+500</font>, and gains an additional <font color='rgb(255,215,0)'>+100 max currency</font> per upgrade level.

Yuta.PassiveDescription:
Every 5 attacks, Yuta randomly gains one of the following buffs: +10% DMG, +10% RNG, or +10% SPA.
Each buff can stack up to a maximum of 50%. (This passive disables if Yuta dies).

Gilgamesh.PassiveDescription:
Each kill that grants money gives this unit +1% DMG per money earned (Max 30%).
When the player's money is above 80% of max, this unit becomes immune to Stun.

SpeedWagon.PassiveDescription:
While in Defense Mode, generates +80 Cash/ 2 sec.
This income is increased by 1.5× with each upgrade.

Gyutaro.PassiveDescription:
Attacks inflict Blood for 8s, dealing 20% of this unit's DMG as damage.
Attacking enemies affected by Blood deals +30% DMG to them.
Attacking enemies affected by both Blood and Burn increases Blood duration to 12s.
Upon deployment, inflicts Blood on all Bosses for 5s.

PassiveDescription.1:
1.) The attack pattern cycles through AoE, Cone, Line, and Single-target attacks.
Each time the pattern changes, a stack is gained (used for the Ultimate).
PassiveDescription.2:
2.) If the device is struck, it deals 0.3x damage back to the attacker.
Additionally, if an ally is near death, the device intercepts the damage intended for that ally for 3 seconds (this effect can trigger once per player).

Broly_Awakened.UltimateDescription:
Unleashes a Full AOE blast, dealing Skill DMG × Max Stacks (1 Stack = 0.2).
Grants allies +1% Current HP as Armor.

Tsunayoshi.PassiveDescription: Skill attacks have a <font color="#FFA500">20% chance</font> to inflict <font color="#FF4500"><u>Burn (Dying Flame)</u></font>,dealing <font color="#FF4500">2% additional DMG</font> over time.

YiSang.PassiveDescription:
Gains +1% DMG for every 100 total deploy cost of your units on the field (Max 80%). If deployed alone, this unit is Rooted (stays like Defend Mode).
Has a 4-round magazine for basic attacks:
• Rounds 1/3 The Living: inflict Slow for 3s.
• Rounds 2/4 The Departed: a Slowed enemy receives Weaken for 3s.
Reload: after 4 rounds this unit is Stunned for 0.5-1s.
When this unit is Stunned, all enemies receive Butterfly for 2.5s (Cooldown 5s).
YiSang.UltimateDescription:
Deals 80% of current DMG to all enemies in range.
Enemies with Butterfly are Stunned for 3s.

Kizaru_Player.PassiveDescription:
Death Re-deployment: When this unit dies, increases UnitCap by +1 (MAX 3). Resets on new match, persists through death.
Defense Mode: Accumulates +1 Photon Point every 0.5s (Up to 20%). Each point increases All Stats by +1%.
Hunt Mode Carryover: Accumulated Photon Points and stat boosts carry over and remain active in Hunt Mode!

Julius.PassiveDescription:
This unit's attacks and skills are highly inaccurate, randomly hitting or missing targets.
Upon the first successful hit on an enemy, it applies a 100% Freeze effect, while subsequent hits on the same target only have a 10% Freeze chance.
Each successful hit grants +1 'Frost Stack' (Max 30), providing the following bonuses: every 5 stacks grants +20% Self-Skill DMG, and every 10 stacks grants +1.5% Luck (e.g., increasing stage drop rates).
Upon reaching 30 stacks, the unit enters the 'Absolute Break' state for 6 seconds, causing all attacks from this unit and its teammates to inflict a 3.4s Freeze (can only affect one enemy at a time while active).

Geto.PassiveDescription:
Each time a Soul is absorbed, Damage is increased by 2.5%.
Resets upon death.

Itadori.PassiveDescription:
Every attack has a 15% chance to stack Black Flash (Max 4).
+5% DMG per stack.

Alucard_Awakened.PassiveDescription:
Every attack inflicts Bleed (45% of DMG) that stacks up to 4 times (Max 10%). Bleed loses 1 stack at a time when the enemy is not hit continuously.
Killing an enemy has a 5-10% chance (based on upgrade level) to turn it into a Vampire ally (Max 4).
Vampires have 10% of this unit's HP and DMG, +5% SPA and Skill Cooldown, and share all other stats.

Naruto.PassiveDescription: Enemy death in range instantly restores <font color='rgb(0,255,0)'>12% HP</font>. (Max 1 trigger per activation, ignores simultaneous deaths).

Wignall.PassiveDescription:
Gains +15% Evade. If allies have Evade, this unit steals it for itself, granting those allies +8% Armor Pierce instead.
If there are more than 20 enemies on the map, those allies' Evade becomes 0.
When there are more than 20 enemies on the map, periodically grows damaging plants at random spots within its range.

Minato.PassiveDescription: When this unit is deployed for the first time, it grants “Inventor” (Mark) to all allies.

Gara.PassiveDescription:
Any enemy that attacks this unit becomes permanently slowed.
If this unit dies, the slow effect on all enemies is immediately removed.

Sukuna_Awakened.PassiveDescription:
1st placement sets all stats to 1 (except Speed).
2nd placement restores base stats.
3rd placement onwards grants +50% Speed and +20% DMG for 15s.
Each placement permanently reduces deployment cost by 5%.
Sukuna_Awakened.UltimateDescription: Deals <font color='rgb(255,80,80)'>DMG to all enemies map-wide</font> while the <font color='rgb(233,170,235)'>Domain</font> is active.

PassiveDescription.1:
With a Solo Leveling ally, whenever a Shadow Soldier is raised this unit Roars (4s cooldown), dealing 30% DMG to every enemy in range and pulling them in.
Each Roar removes 3 Shield from the frontmost enemy.
Increases the Shadow Soldier limit by +2.
PassiveDescription.2:
Every attack has a 50% chance to inflict Poison (100% DMG per second).
Starts with 10 Hunger. Each hit taken removes 1. At 0, all enemies in range are Stunned for 2.3s and Poisoned for 7s (100% DMG per second).
When an enemy attacks your base, this unit is deployed for free ignoring Spawn Cooldown (1 unit, once per match).

Beru.UltimateDescription:
Roars, dealing 50% of this unit's DMG to every enemy in range with a 100% crit chance, and inflicts Fear for 0.4s.
After each Ultimate, all Solo Leveling units (including this unit) gain +10% HP (Max 50%).

PassiveDescription.1:
Gains +2 Shield for each other Solo Leveling unit on the field (not counting itself, no limit).
While Sung Jin-Woo is in range, each attack removes 3 Shield from the enemy.
Increases the Shadow Soldier limit by +2.
PassiveDescription.2:
Every attack inflicts Corrosion 30% for 10s on enemies of an opposing element, or permanently on enemies of the same element.
Enemies cannot Armor Pierce this unit.
Gains +10% Armor and HP per Shadow Soldier on the field (Max 50%) and +10% HP each time a Shadow dies (Max 50%). These stacks are kept after death.
Attacks against armored enemies have a 70% chance to crit, with bonus crit damage equal to 50% of this unit's Armor Pierce (including Corrosion).

PassiveDescription.1:
With a Solo Leveling ally: -40% Skill Cooldown, and Solo Leveling units (including this unit) gain +15% Range and +50% Reward.
When deployed, opens a portal to the farthest Solo Leveling ally.
Increases the Shadow Soldier limit by +2.
PassiveDescription.2:
Every attack has a 70% chance to Slow the enemy by 20% for 3s.
With 1+ Shadow Soldier, enters Demon Sword: +50% DMG and its skill strikes 3 times. The final strike always crits, inflicts Tocsin for 3.5s and deals +100% Skill DMG.
In Defend Mode: -50% DMG, HP and Skill DMG, but whenever an ally attacks, this unit follows up with its skill regardless of range (no portal).
Each dodged attack grants +100 Armor (Max 5,000).

Bellion.UltimateDescription:
Solo Leveling units (including this unit) gain +15% Range for 10s.
Deals 50% of this unit's DMG to every enemy in range (1 Hit). If any enemy shares an element with your Solo Leveling team, the attack ignores range.
Every enemy hit gets Butterfly for 2.4s.
After the Ultimate ends, this unit's attacks permanently inflict Poison (4% DMG) for 2s (stacks).

PassiveDescription.1:
When this unit defeats an enemy, there is an 80% chance to raise it as a Shadow Soldier from your base with 10% of this unit's current stats.
While this unit is on the field, every ally has a 40% chance to raise a Shadow Soldier on kill with 2.5% of this unit's stats.
Shadow Soldier limit: 10. If this unit dies while the limit is full, all Shadow Soldiers die with it, granting this unit +10% HP per Shadow (Max 50%) and +1 Shield to future Shadows (Max 5).
Defeating a Boss deals 50% DMG to every enemy on the field 4 times instead of raising it.
PassiveDescription.2:
When deployed, inflicts Curse (cannot crit) on all enemies for 3.2s.
Normal attacks have a 20% chance to inflict Poison for 4s (also on enemies that lifesteal from this unit). In Hunt Mode the chance is 5% for 2s. Poison deals 50% DMG per second and cannot stack.
Hunter: marks 5 random enemies 👁️‍🗨️. All damage to marked enemies is +50%. When all are gone, a new hunt starts after 5s.
Gains +10% Skill DMG per Shadow Soldier on the field (no limit).
On first contact with an enemy, Slows the 5 nearest enemies by 7% for 1s (once per deployment).

SungJinWoo_Awakened.UltimateDescription:
Instantly raises 3 Shadow Soldiers from your base (limit 10 still applies).
Deals 50% of this unit's DMG (including all passives) to every enemy in range and inflicts Poison (2% DMG) for 4s.
All Shadow Soldiers on the field gain +10% All Stats (does not stack).
Shadow Soldiers already on the field (not the newly raised ones) gain Regeneration (10% HP every 2s) for 1.5s.
If you have more than 1 Shadow Soldier after casting, enemy waves spawn faster by +0.2x per Shadow (Max +2x) for 3.5s.

Luffy_Awakened.PassiveDescription: Every <font color='rgb(255,105,180)'>4 Attacks</font>, enter <font color='rgb(255,105,180)'>Gear Second</font> for <font color='rgb(255,105,180)'>8s</font>. While active, attacks hit <font color='rgb(255,105,180)'>twice</font> and have a <font color='rgb(255,105,180)'>20% chance</font> to <font color='rgb(255,105,180)'>Knock Back</font> enemies.

PassiveDescription.1:
Normal attacks attach an Illusion Card 🃏. When an enemy holds 5 cards, every carded enemy takes 15% bonus DMG and all cards reset.
The burst inflicts Fear on all enemies in range for 2s and grants +10 Gauge to allies that use a gauge.
With more than 5 enemies in range, it strikes each enemy only once before switching targets.
The first deployment each match has a 5% chance to reduce the team's total upgrade cost by 10% (once per match).

Kaitokid.UltimateDescription:
Instantly attaches 1 Illusion Card 🃏 to every enemy in range (stacks up to 5). Enemies reaching 5 cards trigger the card burst.
Grants the player +50 Yen.

Sion.PassiveDescription:
Every 7s creates an Ignition Zone at a random spot anywhere on the map (even if no enemies are there). A fiery meteor falls into the zone, dealing +100% ATK Bonus DMG and inflicting Burn 1.2%.
If an enemy inside the zone has more HP than this unit, the cooldown becomes 13s instead of 7s.

Yamcha.PassiveDescription:
While in Defends Mode: +10% DMG.
While in Hunter Mode: +10% Skill Range.

PassiveDescription.1:
When this unit defeats an enemy, there is an 80% chance to turn it into a Shadow Soldier that rises from your base with 20% of this unit's current stats.
Shadow Soldier limit: 10 (Igris, Beru and Bellion each add +2 when a Solo Leveling ally is present). Bosses cannot be raised.
PassiveDescription.2:
The first time this unit is deployed each match, its DMG, HP and Skill DMG are always 1 (Speed and Range unchanged).
From the second deployment onward, its stats return to normal.

Gabimaru.PassiveDescription:
Allies take 15% less Burn DMG from enemies.
Wind element units (including this unit) inflict Burn 8% on attack.

Lihanna.PassiveDescription:
When this unit evades an attack, the attacker is inflicted with Burn 5% for 4s.
While in Hunt Mode, skill attacks Stun enemies for 0.3s.

Asura.PassiveDescription:
Each attack grants 1 Wrath Stack (Max 20). Each stack grants +2% Base DMG (+40% at 20 stacks). Stacks are kept even if this unit dies.
At max stacks, this unit's deploy cost increases by 25% and Skill hits inflict Burn (20% of DMG) for 4s.

Zoro_Awakened.PassiveDescription: Gains <font color='rgb(255,105,180)'>+2.5% Crit DMG</font> and <font color='rgb(255,105,180)'>+5% Crit Chance</font>.

Toji_Awakened.PassiveDescription:
Skill attacks deal 1.2x DMG to Bosses.
Defeating a Boss within range triggers a Special AOE Attack for 50% DMG.

Broly.PassiveDescription:
Upon being hit by an enemy for the first time, gains 20% Defense and +25% HP.
If killed, permanently gains +10 Defense per death (Max 100).
Selling this unit does not count.

Archer.PassiveDescription:
Normal attacks gain 20% Armor Pierce. Each time this unit breaks enemy Armor, gains +5% DMG (Max 30%).
With a Fate ally, attacks inflict Corrosion based on 2% of Armor Pierce for 1.3s.

Nobara.PassiveDescription: When killing an enemy with higher HP than yourself, you gain <font color='rgb(255,180,0)'>+2.5% RNG</font> per kill. This effect can stack indefinitely.

Itachi_Awakened.PassiveDescription:
20% chance to mark the first enemy in range with Crow Eye for 10s. Slows them by 10% while in range.
Has a chance to Burn all enemies in range for 8s.
Attacking a Crow Eye enemy detonates the mark, ending it early and dealing +20% DMG.

Asura_Awakened.PassiveDescription:
Every attack has a 50% chance to inflict Bleed (5% of DMG). Attacking a Bleeding enemy grants +20% Crit Chance and +2% Crit DMG per hit (stacks up to 20%).
Enemies that Lifesteal from this unit receive Reaper for 3s (does not stack).
While an enemy has Reaper, attacks inflict Corrosion and Crit Chance becomes 100% for 4.2s.
All enemies in range receive Burn (50% of DMG) for 5s (Cooldown 5s).
Asura_Awakened.UltimateDescription:
Inflicts Bleed (50% of current DMG) on every enemy on the field for 5.5s. Bosses take 15% more damage.
Afterwards this unit gains the Fire element for 10s, then receives a permanent Pull (enemies focus this unit) until it dies.

Cid.PassiveDescription:
At the start of each Wave, gains +25% Base DMG for 20s.
Deals +14% DMG to enemies whose HP is more than 10% higher than this unit's HP.

Will.PassiveDescription: Receiving any buff grants <font color='rgb(255,140,0)'>Burn attacks</font> to all teammates for 10s (10s Cooldown, cannot re-trigger while active).

Sukuna.PassiveDescription: <font color='rgb(0,255,0)'>Debuff Immunity</font>. Automatically transfers any received debuff to the first enemy.

Perona.PassiveDescription:
Each enemy that enters this unit's Range adds 1 Despair Stack (once per enemy). Stacks last the whole match, even if this unit dies.
Every 30 Despair Stacks, all enemies on the map with Bleed fall into Sleep.

Cid_Awakened.PassiveDescription:
Builds Atomic Energy from attacks and kills. At 100%, enters Overdrive Mode: +25% DMG and unlocks the Ultimate.
Using the Ultimate inflicts Defense Break on all enemies for 5s. After each Ultimate, gains Immunity and 50% Evade for 7s.
In Overdrive, all attacks gain Gold Time, and killing an enemy worth 100+ money restores 1% Atomic Energy.
In Hunt Mode, attacks inflict stacking Defense Break on every enemy hit, costing 10% Atomic Energy per attack.
Cid_Awakened.UltimateDescription:
Deals bonus damage based on Atomic Energy % (from Skill DMG) to all enemies on the field and inflicts Slow 30% for 3s. These hits have Rupture (ignore Armor and Shield).
If 5+ enemies die from it, restores 100% Atomic Energy and reduces the Ultimate cooldown by 20%.

Tsunayoshi_Awakened.PassiveDescription:
While a Burning enemy is within range, enters Hyper Dying Will, gaining +80% ATK.
Skill attacks have an 80% chance to inflict Dying Flame, dealing 50% additional damage over time.

Okarun.PassiveDescription:
Every attack inflicts Burn (30% of DMG) for 1.2s. Hitting a Burning enemy also inflicts Slow 4% for 3.5s.
Landing a hit on an enemy with Evade applies Tocsin for 2.4s (does not stack).
Enemies that Lifesteal from this unit receive Defense Break (-10% Armor).

Alucard.PassiveDescription:
Every Lifesteal also grants Armor equal to the HP drained (Max 50% of Max HP).
All attacks inflict Bleed (1.5% of DMG).

Shinobu.PassiveDescription:
This unit is immune to Butterfly, Bleed, and Poison debuffs.
Every attack inflicts Poison equal to 5% of the damage dealt.

Akaza.PassiveDescription:
Attacks against enemies affected by Blood gain +25% Armor Penetration.
Repeated attacks on the same enemy grant +20% Skill DMG, up to 50%.

PassiveDescription.1:
On deployment, gains +20% Speed for 2s.
The first 5 attacks inflict Fear and Reaper for 5s.
Each kill grants +10% Crit Rate (Max 7 stacks, lost on death).
Every attack inflicts Burn (10% of the hit) 5 times; the last tick is True Damage (ignores armor). Debuffs do not stack.
PassiveDescription.2:
Every 10 kills grants +20% Skill DMG (Max 5 stacks, lost on death).
When HP drops to 40%: +50% DMG, -50% Attack Speed (faster), Immunity for 10s, 3 Shield (does not stack), and attacks inflict Weaken for 20s.

Toji.PassiveDescription: <font color='rgb(0,255,0)'>+25% Kill Rewards</font> when defeating enemies with higher Max HP than this unit.

Madara.PassiveDescription: If this unit has already been affected by a debuff once, it will become completely immune to that debuff afterward.

Kojiro.PassiveDescription:
Attacking an enemy with 20% more HP than this unit strikes twice.
Enemies that hit this unit are inflicted with Poison (3.7% of main DMG) for 2.5s.

Tanzaburo.PassiveDescription:
When HP drops below 40%, increases attack cooldown (CD) by +4% but grants +20% DMG and +20% Speed.
This unit cannot switch to Defense Mode and will remain in Chase Mode permanently.
Every 15 seconds, it equips the Rider Mask for 30 second, instantly boosting the unit to max upgrade level (Lv.80), changing its attack pattern to Form 2, and inflicting an Anti-Heal debuff (4s) on every strike.

Saber.PassiveDescription: When there is an ally from the Fate series, this unit gains +10% DMG.

Gilgamesh_Awakened.PassiveDescription:
The first deployment refunds 50% of the deploy cost. Every 40 money earned from kills grants +1% DMG (Max 40%).
Gains Immunity every time it is deployed.
Gains +4% Skill DMG for every ally unit (1 Cap) in Defense Mode. When all allies are in Defense Mode, also gains +20% Range.
Gilgamesh_Awakened.UltimateDescription:
Gains +80% Range, then deals 100% of current DMG to all enemies in range and heals 50% of the damage dealt.
Cuts the Shield of every enemy on the map by half.

Tanjiro.PassiveDescription: The <font color='rgb(255,105,180)'>Burn</font> inflicted by this Unit lasts <font color='rgb(255,105,180)'>2s longer</font>. Gains a special effect: <font color='rgb(255,105,180)'>Immune to Burn inflicted by enemy attacks</font>. Attacks apply <font color='rgb(255,105,180)'>Hinokami Mark</font>. Fire-element Units and Allies that attack marked enemies inflict <font color='rgb(255,105,180)'>+0.5% stronger Burn</font>.

Kakashi.PassiveDescription: <font color='rgb(0,255,0)'>+7% DMG</font> when placed (Once per game only).

Saber_Awakened.PassiveDescription:
Critical hits inflict Fear for 1s. In Hunt Mode, Crit Chance becomes 50%.
Critical skill hits grant 1 Dragon Force Stack (Max 10), used by the Ultimate.
Saber_Awakened.UltimateDescription:
Deals 100% of current DMG to all enemies in range and Stuns them for 4.5s.
Consumes all Dragon Force Stacks: +5% DMG per stack (Max 50%).

Kizaru.PassiveDescription:
Death Re-deployment: When this unit dies, increases UnitCap by +1 (MAX 3). Resets on new match, persists through death.
Defense Mode: Accumulates +1 Photon Point every 0.5s (Up to 20%). Each point increases All Stats by +1%.
Hunt Mode Carryover: Accumulated Photon Points and stat boosts carry over and remain active in Hunt Mode!

Atalanta.PassiveDescription:
Attacks against far enemies in range inflict Bleed 2.5%.
When an enemy evades this unit's attack, gains +70% Accuracy and +50% Crit Chance for 5s.

Colette.PassiveDescription: When Will or Will (Limit Off) is on the field, they gain +5% Kill Reward.

Doflamingo_Player.PassiveDescription:
Each Skill Attack inflicts Stun for 1.3s, up to 3 times per enemy.
After 15s, warps to a random allied One Piece unit and gains +100% HP.
Can only warp once per game.
This unit will only deal 10 DMG after warping.

Ishtar.PassiveDescription:
When first deployed, strikes the first enemy on the map regardless of range.
Gains 1 Pride Stack every 2.5s. At 10 Stacks, strikes 1 enemy regardless of range with +20% Crit DMG (does not stack).

PassiveDescription.1:
1.) While in Defense Mode, grants +10% Crit DMG and +10% Crit Chance to all units below Secret rarity.
All attack types inflict Blood, dealing 15% of this unit's DMG over 10s.
PassiveDescription.2:
2.) When this unit takes damage exceeding 80% of its HP, gains Armor equal to 10% of Max HP.
Every enemy attack reflects 10% of the damage taken back to the attacking enemy.

Will_Awakened.PassiveDescription:
Every attack from this unit and its teammates grants +1 Fracture Stack (Max 10). The team's subsequent attacks will randomly trigger one effect by consuming 1 Fracture Stack per attack (cannot trigger if stacks are at 0):

1. Focus Fire: Teammates target the same enemy as this unit and gain +20% DMG for that round.
2. Advance: Teammates receive +15% HP and +15% SPD.
3. Hold Line: This unit's own attack damage is added to the teammates' attacks when they strike.

Buddha.PassiveDescription:
In Defense Mode, this unit deals 0 DMG and gains Map-Wide Range.
Skill Attacks inflict Slow 30% for 5s.
Grants Armor equal to 35% of its HP to all Ragnarok units except itself, once per life.
Units that have already received this Armor buff will not receive it again when redeployed.
If a buffed unit's Armor reaches 0, this unit can grant the Armor buff again.

Nezuko.PassiveDescription: Every <font color='rgb(255,105,180)'>1% Dodge</font> is converted into <font color='rgb(255,105,180)'>0.1% Burn Damage</font>.

Geto_Awakened.PassiveDescription: Every time an enemy dies within Geto's attack range, grants <font color='rgb(0,255,0)'>+2% DMG</font> (Permanent Stack).

Gojo_Awakened.PassiveDescription:
For each enemy within range, gain +0.1% RNG and DMG.
This effect stacks for every enemy that enters the range and resets to the base value when no enemies remain.
Every attack inflicts Slow for 4s.
Gojo_Awakened.UltimateDescription:
Cleanses all debuffs from this unit and allies.
Freezes all enemies map-wide, excluding allies.
Upon ending, deals 1 Hit to all enemies.

Finn.PassiveDescription:
Each attack has a 45% chance to inflict Bleed, causing enemies to take 15% of the attack's DMG over time.
When Bleed is applied, grants +5% Speed to this unit and all teammates with Luminous or Water elements.

Zoro.PassiveDescription: Attacks inflict <font color='rgb(255,105,180)'>Bleed</font>, dealing damage equal to <font color='rgb(255,105,180)'>2% of Base DMG</font>.

Luffy.PassiveDescription: Every <font color='rgb(255,105,180)'>4 Attacks or Skill uses</font>, the next Attack deals <font color='rgb(255,105,180)'>20% bonus damage</font> and <font color='rgb(255,105,180)'>Slows the enemy</font>.

Megumi.PassiveDescription: Enemies outside the range will be slowed for 3 seconds. (Only activates upon death.)
